fact: EcoMatin reported on 1 September 2023 that in almost all public hospitals in Cameroon paper medical files are often lost in archiving and the paper carnet médical, whose purchase conditions any care, is still in use, the electronic medical record not yet being operational and having no launch date.
title: Santé publique : le gouvernement en quête d’une expertise étrangère pour opérationnaliser la digitalisation des dossiers médicaux
